text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho, the final hurdle of the Classic Triple Crown, is here at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru—a runner who's just entering her prime and who has also dominated the preliminary match—issues a challenge to Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Will Mejiro Bright's sleeper stayer abilities be enough to compete against such a runner?
